title: (BP's) Blocky Font
description: A cute blocky font inspired by the original to give a more cubic / minecrafty feel :)
body:
![Pack Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f702722d0597d7a2c61e71a59a857c7a8a0d87ff.png)
# Description
I made this pack to change the default minecraft font to something a bit more.. well, blockier. In my opinion, it makes the font blend in better with Minecraft's style for due to this game's very _blocky_ nature.


This pack changes all letters, numbers and symbols. It (partly) supports accents/diacritics but not completely. Hopefully I will deal with that in the future - fingers crossed future me even remembers this pack.

## Compatibility
This pack will work for all modern versions of Minecraft. if you get the "This pack is made for a newer/older version of Minecraft" message, just turn the pack on anyway and it will work as normal.

This pack is also fully compatible with any other mods/resource packs so no need to worry about compatibility nightmares etc. 😀

_If anyone wants to do the accents/diacritics then just message me on discord ok byee_
